source_snapshot.criteria: SSIF Bus between SMA and BMC is functional.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_I2C_bus1; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes generic BMC i2cdetect/i2cget plus operator inspection, which tests address presence rather than SSIF function.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; held Pending for exact path/endpoint, supported SSIF stack, request/response framing and completion/payload oracle, physical evidence and recovery.

old_problem: An address ACK or arbitrary register read cannot prove IPMI-over-SMBus SSIF. The source omits the supported BMC stack/tool, SMA slave identity, request netfn/command/payload, framing/PEC/multipart behavior, completion code, response data and timing oracle.
disposition_reason: This row requires protocol functionality, not generic I2C presence. The missing request and authoritative response define the core command semantics and PASS/FAIL basis; inventing or freely parameterizing them could issue an unsupported raw transaction on the live management bus. Physical evidence and a bus map alone cannot close that gap, so Pending remains.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2159, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2160 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00047-V002 / d52bd493398f0f40 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind logical I2C-1 to the BMC controller/adapter/mux/channel, SMA connector and SSIF slave identity through the approved BMC/OOB path.
Owner must specify the supported SSIF stack or vendor utility and exact read-only IPMI request netfn/command/payload plus SMBus framing, PEC/multipart, response completion/data and timing oracle.
Operator must verify and photograph the SMA-to-BMC physical path; this does not substitute for the protocol exchange.
Generic i2cdetect/i2cget, ACK-only evidence, arbitrary raw SMBus writes or unrelated IPMI transports cannot satisfy the criterion.
Preserve SSIF-driver/SMBus errors and stop on malformed response, timeout, PEC/framing error, stuck bus or endpoint/BMC instability; no blind retry/reset.
No bus query, SSIF transaction, physical manipulation, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: End-to-end SMA-to-BMC SSIF protocol functional validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the physical SMA-to-BMC path mapped as BMC I2C-1 supports a valid end-to-end SSIF management transaction with the correct endpoint, framing, completion status and payload.
required_package: Authoritative BMC I2C-1 controller/mux/SMA/SSIF endpoint map
Vendor-supported BMC SSIF driver/tool and exact safe request/response specification
SMBus speed, PEC, multipart, timing and retry behavior contract
Operator physical inspection/photo procedure and trusted BMC access
SSIF/SMBus error limits, abort and vendor recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending Engineering Decision. Preserve bus/driver evidence and perform no generic scan or raw transaction. After approval, operator proves the physical link, then use only the supported BMC SSIF stack to issue the exact signed read-only request and capture full request, framing, completion code, payload, timing and SSIF/SMBus health.
test_case.expected_result: The approved request reaches the intended SMA endpoint over the mapped I2C-1 path and returns the exact permitted completion, payload and framing/PEC/multipart behavior within timing limits, with clean bus/driver health and matching physical evidence.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until the exact request and authoritative response oracle are approved. PASS requires complete protocol and physical evidence. FAIL on incorrect completion/payload/framing, timeout, wrong endpoint/path or bus fault. Missing core protocol semantics remains BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until endpoint, supported stack, exact transaction/oracle and recovery are signed.
Physical work is operator-only; use the BMC/platform-management path.
No generic ACK as functional proof, arbitrary raw SMBus write, guessed IPMI command, blind reset or automatic retry.
Stop on malformed response, PEC/framing/multipart error, timeout, stuck bus or BMC/SMA instability.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval and SMA-to-BMC connector photos
Controller/adapter/mux/channel/SMA connector and SSIF slave identity
Supported tool/driver and exact request netfn/command/payload
Complete response framing, completion code, payload, timing, PEC/multipart evidence
Pre/post SSIF-driver and SMBus error/health records
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve the failed request/response and bus/driver logs. Use only the owner-approved SSIF/BMC recovery path; do not resend, write raw data or blindly reset. Quarantine and escalate if the management path does not return to baseline.
